He knew his quest meant crossing the raging water, a treacherous river filled with serpents. He steeled himself, took a deep breath and jumped in before his mum could call him in for tea.

I glance my reflection in the pool,
the me of shadows and moonlit ripple.

How did she come to this place?
Of broken shell and #timid star,
of stony sand and windswept dream?

I reach, but I cannot touch her,
for she floats in seas and drifts in memory.
